name: GlitchTip
description: GlitchTip is an open-source error tracking platform that accepts events from the Sentry SDKs, so existing apps only need a new DSN. It groups exceptions into issues with stack traces and releases, and also offers uptime monitoring, performance traces, log ingestion and alerts by email, webhook or chat.

notes.text: Self-signup is off. Add users in the Django admin at /admin/, or set ENABLE_USER_REGISTRATION=True in /opt/glitchtip_data/.env.
Emails (invites, password resets) only go to the service log until you set EMAIL_URL to your SMTP server in /opt/glitchtip_data/.env.
Behind a domain or reverse proxy, set GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN in /opt/glitchtip_data/.env: project DSNs are built from it.
